_about: Top 100 bite, identification and droppings pages to build, 10 a day for 10 days from Oct 27, 2026 (owner, Oct 26). Demand from saved Ahrefs US volumes (before the Oct 25 cancellation) and Search Console. Score = demand x type weight (bites 1.3, sorters 1.25, look-alikes/life stages/droppings 1.2, species 0.9, X vs Y 0.8) x difficulty (KD<=10 1.0, <=30 0.8, <=50 0.6, more 0.35); garden pests and medical bite searches x0.6. Days 1-6: winter and year-round pages (they earn impressions now); days 7-10: summer pages (they age through winter for the May-August peak). Every page still goes through beat-the-top-3 research, the photo-ID writer brief, an independent fact-check and real PD/CC0/CC BY photos. Overlaps lists live pages to link to and not to cannibalize.
